baseline.regression_red: Native direct-Part control passes; native rigid-body link reference test segfaults the same unmodified source process. Red-capable command uses -P src/Mod/Fem/femtest/app -t test_constraint_links.TestConstraintLinks.test_direct_part_control -t test_constraint_links.TestConstraintLinks.test_rigid_body_link_face.

cause: Native Constraint::onChanged and getPoints cast arbitrary reference DocumentObjects to Part::Feature, then dereference Shape. App::Link is not Part::Feature. Full-shape scaling and specialized Bearing/Transform callbacks had related assumptions; link placement changes were also excluded by the GeoFeature-only observer gate.
fix: Resolve selected occurrences using Part::Feature::getShape on generic DocumentObjects with NeedSubElement/ResolveLink/Transform, then compose only enclosing geometry-group placement. Avoid replacing the selected occurrence with its source. Use generic full-shape scaling, clear symbols on unresolved references, reject invalid geometry during recompute and observe link Placement changes. Remove reference casts from Bearing/cylindrical Transform and unsafe native Bearing Location geometry access. Invalid references no longer keep old Points/Normals.
